rules.statement: A counterfactual may change exactly one declared dimension.
Counterfactual values must come from the case contract.
No free-form or generative domain values may be invented.
A case may have at most three counterfactual variants.
Counterfactual output is diagnostic and not authoritative evidence.
Counterfactual runs may call only the existing local pipeline.
Counterfactual runs may not trigger expert routing.
A missing required decision transition produces a scope-leak objection.
An original ANSWER is preserved only when every required transition passes.
